remarks: Discover timeless charm and unbeatable convenience in this desirable pre-war building, perfectly situated in one of Stamford's most sought-after locations. Just moments from award-winning restaurants, premier shopping, theaters, Metro-North, I-95, and everything downtown has to offer, this spacious one-bedroom home is ideal for commuters and those seeking a vibrant urban lifestyle. Located on the second floor, this light-filled residence has been freshly painted and features gleaming hardwood floors, an updated bathroom, generous closet space, and a beautifully renovated kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. The kitchen opens seamlessly to the living room, creating a bright, open-concept layout that's perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Natural light pours in throughout the home, enhancing its warm and inviting feel. Beautifully manicured grounds, abundant storage, and on-site laundry add to the home's everyday convenience. Garage parking may be available for an additional $50 per month through a waitlist, offering an excellent option for those seeking covered parking. Whether you're searching for a wonderful place to call home or a turnkey investment opportunity, this property delivers. Move right in and enjoy everything Stamford has to offer, or start generating rental income immediately with this investor-friendly opportunity. Click on movie icon for virtual tour.
